column3: We are going to school tomorrow.
I do not want to eat rice today.
Will you come to my place for dinner tomorrow?
I want to drink some water.
She is reading in the library.
Let us go to Beijing together.
This is my friend, his name is Zhang Ming.
Let us go and study at the library.
Sorry, I cannot go to school today.
How many friends do you have?
Every day I eat with my friends.
A friend gave me a book.
My friend works as a teacher.
